_how: The gift guides landing's Top 10, in order: all ten named by the owner (2026-11-21 ~5:05 PM; spot 1 swapped to the Theragun Mini, owner 11-21 evening: 'put the other Theragun here'; its Ulta link, as on the Her guide). To swap an item, change its href to the link of any pick on Her, Him or Kids (src/content/giftGuidePicks/her.json, him.json, kids.json) and its guide to that file's name; name is only a reminder. autoReplace false (the default) = always this item. Set autoReplace to true on a spot ONLY when the owner says so: that spot then goes to the most-clicked pick with at least 20 clicks in 14 days (src/content/giftGuideEarnRank.json, refreshed by scripts/gift-guide-earn-rank.mjs), and keeps this item until one qualifies. Keep exactly 10 entries.
